answer: Fingerprints are enrolled through a cancellable transform that can be revoked and reissued, and each epoch checks the transformed template, so a leaked template is revoked instead of reused forever. A thousand aliases need a thousand distinct fingers, and a stolen transform is cancelled by its owner, while one honest agent presses one finger and moves on. The reef of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the karst of honest work is what finally pays.
